client_crs.name: NAD_1983_Texas_Albers_Equal_Area
client_crs.why: Equal-area projection preserves area for accurate flood impact calculations. Conformal projections (StatePlane) distort area, which is unacceptable for overlap area and cross-sectional volume measurements. Texas Albers provides area accuracy across the entire state.

impact_rule.notes: A parcel is impacted if (cumulative_cross_sectional_area_sf >= min_cumulative_cross_sectional_area_sf) OR (max_single_year_cross_sectional_area_sf >= min_single_year_cross_sectional_area_sf) OR (cumulative_overlap_pct >= min_cumulative_overlap_pct) OR (max_single_year_overlap_pct >= min_single_year_overlap_pct). Cross-sectional area (3D volume) = depth × area. Cumulative sums across 3 historical years (2016, 2017, 2018). Buildings are not considered — analysis focuses on land flood frequency for both developed and vacant parcels.
